name: @lei/web
//typescript-in-dependencies: The deploy host installs production dependencies only. next build type-checks, so without these it decides TypeScript is 'not installed', shells out to yarn to fetch them mid-build, and yarn dies on an engine mismatch (cookie@2.0.1 wants Node >=22, the host runs 20) that npm only warns about. Same reason typescript and @nestjs/cli sit in dependencies over in apps/api.
